title: Choir Rehearsal
tagline: A private rehearsal library for choirs: songs, voice tracks, PDF scores, and easy listening on phone or desktop.
overview: Choir Rehearsal helps choir members learn new pieces by voice part. Editors upload PDF scores and audio for each voice (or record from a phone). Singers visit /rehearsal/, pick a song, and listen to their part.
features: Song list on your choir website
Voice tracks: bass, tenor, alto, soprano, and more
Sticky player at the bottom of the screen

pricing.name: Lite
items: Up to 4 voice tracks per song

pricing.name: Done-for-you setup
items: One-time setup on your WordPress site

orderSteps: Subscribe at shop.compath.ee (Stripe Checkout) or email order@compath.ee for setup services.
After payment you receive a license key and download link for Choir Rehearsal Pro.
Install Choir Rehearsal (Lite) and Choir Rehearsal Pro on your WordPress site.
installSteps: Download choir-rehearsal.zip (Lite) from GitHub Releases or WordPress.org.
Pro customers: install choir-rehearsal-pro.zip from the SureCart customer dashboard.
In WordPress: Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin — select the zip and activate.
The plugin creates a /rehearsal/ page with the [choir_rehearsal] shortcode.
Add a song: Choir Rehearsal → Add Song — title, PDF, voice tracks.
Give singers WordPress accounts (Subscriber role). Editors get Editor or Administrator.
